Bryan Hodgson Radio Show to broadcast live from Track 15 on October 29
The Bryan Hodgson Radio Show will air live from Track 15 in Providence on October 29. Hosted by Kevin McNamara, the show features interviews with Coach Hodgson and student-athletes Malik Mack and Leonardo Marangon.
The Bryan Hodgson Radio Show will air live from Track 15 at 1 Union Station in Providence, Rhode Island, on October 29 from 6 to 7 p.m., according to an Oct. 22 announcement. Listeners can tune in on NewsTalk 99.7 FM and AM 630 WPRO.
Hosted by Kevin McNamara of WPRO, the show will include interviews with Coach Bryan Hodgson, student-athletes Malik Mack and Leonardo Marangon, as well as Track 15 founder Chris Marsella. Fans may also stream the program online at www.997wpro.com or through The Varsity Network. After the broadcast, the episode will be available on WPRO's podcast page and via YouTube at PCFriarsMBB on X.
In addition to the radio show, fans are encouraged to attend the Friars' second home exhibition game against Georgia Tech on Saturday, October 24 at noon at Amica Mutual Pavilion in Providence. The team is scheduled to open its season versus Maine on Monday, November 2 at Amica Mutual Pavilion with a start time of 7 p.m. Tickets are available through Friars.com or by calling their ticket office.
Future episodes of The Bryan Hodgson Radio Show are scheduled for Thursday, November 12; Thursday, December 3; and Tuesday, December 15—the last of which will take place at Providence Diamond.
